_about: ALL design values for ColdTrust Twin live here. Change a number here and every screen, test and graph uses the new value.

site.name: Visakhapatnam
site._note: Sea-level pressure used until real weather (PS) is loaded.

chamber._note: U = k / thickness = 0.022 / 0.100 = 0.22 W/m2K. Air films and thermal bridges ignored (see ASSUMPTIONS.md).

door._note: Openings/hour and seconds/opening are design-point guesses. In LIVE mode the door switch gives the real open fraction.

pcm.name: Paraffin (organic)
pcm.latent_range_note: Datasheet range for this paraffin is 190-200 kJ/kg. We use the LOWER value (190) to be safe.
pcm._note: Slab thickness = mass / (density * area) = 115/(800*12) = 12 mm. 'Fully used' = all wax liquid and warmed to the 8 C top of the band.

grid_backup._note: Automatic transfer switch moves the compressor to grid when PCM battery < 15 % and there is no solar power.

physics_check._note: If |measured - predicted| room temperature stays above threshold for longer than persist_minutes, the sensor is flagged.

design_ambient._note: A typical hot, humid Visakhapatnam summer afternoon, used for the design-point report.
